name: chat-decision
why: The core red surface: a real decision reached in conversation with nothing on disk to show for it. The repo is spotless, so git tells the skill nothing.
seed: We spent this session working out how to version the public API. We settled on URL-path versioning (/v1/, /v2/) rather than an Accept header, because the CDN can route on the path without inspecting headers. We agreed it but did not write it down anywhere — no ADR, no issue, no code. Nothing in the repo was touched.

items.about: the URL-path API versioning decision, agreed in conversation but not written into docs/decisions/ or any other store

forbid: any uncommitted, untracked, unpushed or stashed git work — the repo is clean and fully pushed
